title: Debug stale closure in React useEffect — 3 turns
description: useEffect has stale closure due to empty dependency array. Fix deps array, run tests, extract to custom hook.

task_spec.prompt: The `useAutoSave` hook has a stale closure bug — the useEffect dependency array is `[]` so it captures `content`, `onSave`, and `delayMs` only at mount time. Fix it by changing the dependency array to `[content, onSave, delayMs]`. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. Now implement `useLatestRef<T>(value: T)` in `src/useLatestRef.ts` — add a useEffect that sets `ref.current = value` whenever value changes (dep array: [value]). Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.
Final verification: run `npm test -- --forceExit` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — fix any failures now.
success_criteria: useAutoSave dep array includes content, onSave, delayMs
Auto-save debounces correctly and saves with latest content
useLatestRef updates ref.current on each render
